newsitem.title: USA: Laser Photonics doesn't know why shrs down. [CORRECTED 14:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Laser Photonics doesn't know why shrs down. [CORRECTED 14:22 GMT]

text.p: Laser Photonics said Friday that it knows of no reason for the recent decline in its stock price. The company said all of its business segments are proceeding according to plan.
Laser Photonics develop medical and scientific laser systems.
Its stock closed at 2-3/8 Thursday, after hitting a 52-week low of 1-1/2 earlier in the day, said company spokesman Carl Caserta.
(Corrects to make clear that closing price was not down 1-1/2 on Thursday)
